Kuvitus: talvi-ilta. Etualalla punainen: Illustration: a winter evening. In the foreground is a red detached house with light shining from its windows, and an electric car connected to the charger on its wall. A power line runs from the house along poles far across a lake. On the other shore of the lake is a power plant with steam rising from its chimney and its cooling tower, and next to it three wind turbines.
Energiavirtakuvio mittakaavassa lauhdevo: A to-scale energy flow diagram of a condensing power plant. From the left comes the fuel power of 500 MW as a wide grey band. In the first stage, the boiler, the efficiency is 0.90: an orange loss band of 50 MW turns down from the band, and 450 MW remains. In the second stage, the steam cycle, the efficiency is 0.45: a wide loss band of 248 MW turns down, and 203 MW remains. In the third stage, the generator and the transformer, the efficiency is 0.98 and the loss only 4 MW. A green band of electricity leaves to the right, 198 MW, that is, about 40 per cent of the fuel power. The losses become waste heat.
Kuvaaja: talon sähkönkulutus vuorokaudes: Graph: the house's daily electricity consumption E as a function of the outdoor temperature T. Eight black points at temperatures −19…2 °C. A falling straight line is fitted to the points and extended as a dashed line in both directions. The line passes through the points (−20 °C, 191 kWh) and (0 °C, 93 kWh); these two points of the line are circled, and the slope, about −4.9 kWh per degree, is read from them. At the temperature −28 °C about 230 kWh is read from the line. The line falls to the level of the other consumption, 12 kWh, at about 17 °C.
Käsitekartta. Ylhäällä solmu energia säi: Concept map. At the top is the node energy is conserved: E initial equals E final. Three branches lead down from it. Power: P = ΔE / Δt, energy from power E = P t and the kilowatt-hour 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ. Efficiency: eta = E a / E o, losses E o = E a + E h and the energy chain, in which eta is the product of the efficiencies of the stages, eta 1 eta 2 eta 3. Source of energy: fuel Q = H m, work W = F s and work of lifting W = m g h.
